title: [Salty's Services, Exterior]
description: A promenade off of some wide sand-stuck stairs leads up from the distant beach and opens on a metal-patched driftwood warehouse.  Before the warehouse is a boardwalk-style through-way that is mostly empty.  Occasional fishers, gaudily dressed merchants, or townsfolk pass.  Adjacent to the warehouse, a small and seaweed-lined shack is built and lit by torches lining its walls.  pposite and across the promenade from the shack, a distressed hovel leans against the warehouse.
